additionalRules: A Ride Out Army must always contain Theoden, who is always the Army's General.
Riders of Rohan do not count towards this Army's Bow Limit.

specialRules.name: "Now for wrath, now for ruin and the red dawn"
specialRules.text: When a friendly Cavalry model Moves, it must Charge if able. Additionally, on a turn in which a friendly Cavalry model Charges, they gain a bonus of +1 to their Strength and may re-roll any 1s during a Duel Roll that turn.

specialRules.name: "The horn of Helm Hammerhand shall sound in the deep; one last time"
specialRules.text: Once per game, at the start of any Move phase, you can declare you are using this special rule. Until the end of the turn, friendly Cavalry models gain the Terror special rule.

specialRules.name: "For Death and Glory"
specialRules.text: Friendly models gain the Fearless special rule.

units.name: Theoden
options: Exchange Armour for Heavy Armour - 5 points

specialRules.name: Herugrim
specialRules.text: This is a Unique hand weapon. Additionally, if a model armed with Herugrim is involved in a Drawn Combat where the Combat is tied at this model's Fight Value, then instead of rolling off to see who wins, this model wins instead. If both sides have a similar special rule, roll off as normal.

specialRules.name: Forth, and Fear no Darkness
specialRules.text: The range of Théoden's Stand Fast is 12" rather than 6".

specialRules.name: Ring of Barahir
specialRules.text: This is a Unique piece of Wargear. Whenever Aragorn is affected by a Magical Power, after any Resist Tests have been made (if able), he may roll a D6. On a natural 6, Aragorn is not affected by that Magical Power.

specialRules.name: Deadly Shot
specialRules.text: Legolas may make three shooting attacks during the Shoot Phase instead of one, using all the normal rules for shooting.

specialRules.name: Pinpoint Shot
specialRules.text: Instead of shooting normally, Legolas may make a single shooting attack against an enemy model Engaged in Combat with a friendly model (including himself). If the To Hit Roll is successful, Legolas doesn't need to make any In The Way Rolls.

units.name: Captain of Rohan
options: Exchange Armour for Heavy Armour - 5 points

specialRules.name: Royal Standard of Rohan
specialRules.text: This is a Unique banner with a range of 6". Gamling does not suffer the -1 penalty to his Duel Roll for carrying a banner. Additionally, whenever a friendly Rohan Hero model within 6" of the Royal Standard of Rohan spends a Might Point, they may roll a D6. On a natural 6, the Might Point is free and is not spent.

specialRules.name: Arise, Riders of Rohan!
specialRules.text: If this model is within 12" of a Rohan General and has the Cavalry keyword, then it gains a bonus of +1 to its Fight Value in a turn in which it Charges.

specialRules.name: Spear Mastery
specialRules.text: This model may use its throwing spear as a normal spear during the Fight Phase, so long as it hasn't made a shooting attack with it in either the preceding Move Phase or Shoot Phase.
